versions.content: Impact of the DiagnosticComControlClass on the state management for VLANs The impact of the DiagnosticComControlClass on the state management for VLANs can have two alternative consequences: • All VLANs are affected. For this purpose, the reference in the role allPhysi- calChannels has the ability to identify the applicable VLAN. It may seem counterintuitive to require a reference to all applicable VLANs when the expected semantics is actually to define an impact on all of them. However, there could be private VLANs that are not participating in the diagnos- tics work-flow: These need to be kept out of scope and therefore the explicit identification of applicable VLANs makes sense. • A selected number of VLANs is affected. This is conceptually different from the other use case in that it requires an additional attribute that keeps a subnet- Number that is typically assigned by the OEM role.
